text: hey what is the difference between me running tools/rjit game play VS going to the /compiled route in hmsc int
resolution: Explained the current distinction between tools/rjit game play and hmsc-int /compiled: both consume the same baked zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile/contentstore artifact, but game play rebakes, rebuilds, and launches the standalone no-V8 world_loader binary externally, while /compiled embeds the WorldLoader primitive inside the hmsc-int editor host and reloads after the chrome Compile button runs tools/rjit game bake. No code changes were needed.
